title: Product Comparison Videos for Clearer Choices | AIVideosUGC
description: Show shoppers the difference between your colors, sizes or sets. One photo of both options becomes a comparison clip for listings, Shorts and paid ads.
h1: Help Shoppers Compare Your Products Side by Side
lead: Turn one product photo into a product comparison video that gives shoppers a clear result, ready for the channel where you sell.
benefits_h2: Make the product comparison result clear

steps_h2: How to Make Product Comparison Videos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Three simple steps turn one product photo into a comparison result you can post where shoppers choose.

steps.d: Add one clear source photo with both options in view. Keep each full silhouette and surface visible at a similar scale.
Choose a side-by-side scene and describe the difference shoppers should see. Keep the action focused on one comparison.
Download the result and add exact offer or listing details in your editor. Post the finished comparison where shoppers choose.

faq.q: What is a product comparison video template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made side-by-side scene. Add your own options and generate a comparison that helps shoppers choose.
Compare variants such as sizes, colors, finishes or included pieces when both options are visible in your source photo.
Upload one clear photo that shows both options completely, at a similar scale and in even light.

faq.q: Can one photo show both options?
faq.a: Yes. A single frame with both products visible gives the comparison one consistent reference.

faq.q: Can I compare colors, sizes, finishes or sets?
faq.a: Yes. The scene can show visible differences in color, size, finish or included pieces.

faq.q: Do I need to write a prompt?
faq.a: No. Choose a comparison scene and add a short description of the difference you want shoppers to see.

faq.q: Which video size should I choose?
faq.a: Use 1:1 for a product gallery, 16:9 for a listing embed or 9:16 for Shorts and Reels.
Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds; the credit cost is shown before you start.

faq.q: Can I add prices or variant names after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact names, measurements and prices in your editor after downloading.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot day?
faq.a: No. The comparison is generated from your product photo, so you do not need a second shoot or studio booking.

faq.q: Where can I use the comparison video?
faq.a: Use the download in product listings, product pages, Shorts, Reels and paid ads that fit your channel.

visual.overview: A comparison video puts two options side by side so shoppers can choose the size, finish or set that suits them.

steps.sourceTitle: Two sizes of a matte storage canister
steps.sourceHint: Keep the small and large slate-gray canisters, rounded lids and blank surfaces fully visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded pair as the exact options: one small and one large matte slate-gray storage canister with rounded lids and blank surfaces. Preserve each silhouette and relative size. An adult holds one in each hand beside a pale wood table and raises both equally to show the scale difference. Bright natural home light, chest-up front-facing framing. Sound: soft room tone and two gentle ceramic taps; no music.
